judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and wrong TypeScript type names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`). It completely omitted the opt-in configuration flag (`HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}`), leaving the feature unconditionally enabled. Furthermore, it directly violated a core acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor`, rather than adding `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` and returning an error frame. It also missed the 1–200 range check on `limit` in validation (allowing 0 and >200), omitted `StoreCannotList`, failed to update `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, and left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree.
